evidence.text: A think-tank white paper asserts the aquifer is uncontaminated.
The water board's sampling finds benzene above limits; the paper's methodology note concedes it never sampled.
An industry survey claims 82% adoption of the new protocol.
An audit finds the survey sampled only vendors; the response rate was 6%.
The standards body notes the sample was not representative.
A bestselling book claims the bridge design is the safest ever built.
A review quotes the book's claim.
The engineering review board flags three unmodeled failure modes; the book's appendix concedes no structural analysis was done. A second review concurs.
A viral exposé claims the election count was rigged.
The certified recount matches the original tally; the exposé's footage is shown to be from a different year.
A press release touts the drug's 95% efficacy.
A news brief repeats the press release figure.
The trial registry shows the primary endpoint was missed; the release quoted a post-hoc subgroup.
A documentary asserts the factory closed in 2019.
Tax filings show continuous operation through 2025; the film's timeline cites no records.
Employee payroll records corroborate the filings.
The attendance sheet lists the quorum as met.
The meeting minutes record the quorum call.
The lease's paragraph 4 forbids subletting.
The tenant's email claims verbal permission was given.
